name: Kuldeep Sen
bio: Someone who can consistently bowl in the 140s, Kuldeep Sen is a fast bowler who has represented Madhya Pradesh in India's domestic circuit. Known for his ability to bowl quick and take wickets consistently, he had a decent season for the Rajasthan Royals in 2022 where the pacer picked 8 wickets in 7 games, but owing to lack of experience in the shortest format, he proved to be quite expensive during that season. He didn't feature in many games for the following two seasons for the Rajasthan Royals, but he was bagged by the Punjab Kings for 80 lakhs during the IPL auctions in Jeddah.

name: Rajat Patidar
bio: In an era of style over substance, Rajat Patidar comes from the old school of performance at the domestic levels. Born in Indore, Patidar took to cricket as a bowler and then turned seriously into the game as a batter at the U-15 level. Having made his domestic debut for Madhya Pradesh during the 2015-16 season, it took the stylish batter a couple of seasons to find his feet. Patidar top-scored for his team in the 2018-19 domestic season and that set himself up for higher honours. A Duleep Trophy call-up was soon followed by his first IPL stint, after being bought by the Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) ahead of the 2021 season. He scored 333 runs at an impressive strike-rate for RCB, including 112* in the Eliminator — and went on to captain RCB in the IPL.
